final: SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_count), AVG(pair_count * 1.0 / total_count) FROM (SELECT tradekind, transreg, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS pair_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT transreg)) OVER () AS total_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg GROUP BY transreg, tradekind) GROUP BY tradekind
